blocks.title: Safety reading
blocks.content:
Under the Wound Dressing profile, this construct clears every assessed gate but sits close to one.
Toxicity (ToxinPred3) measures 0.355 against a threshold of 0.380 from the predictor's own cut-off, which is at or below the limit. The value sits within ten percent of the threshold.
Haemolysis (HemoPI2) measures 0.294 against a threshold of 0.550 from the predictor's own cut-off, which is at or below the limit.
Immunogenicity (MHC-I) has no measured value, so it is reported as not assessed rather than as a pass. The pipeline's rule is that an unassessed metric does not eliminate a candidate.
Soft signals, which do not veto: B-cell epitope (soft) 0.235 (threshold 0.151).

blocks.title: Peptide origin and composition
blocks.content:
The peptide is 16 residues, drawn from legacy_uniref90_2022 (dataset version 2022-05-01).
Composition: 8 hydrophobic residues (50%), 1 charged (6%), 0 aromatic (0%).
1 cysteine residue present, which allows disulfide formation and can stiffen the peptide against proteolysis.
One-dimensional AGGRESCAN gives -0.216, below zero, which indicates a low intrinsic aggregation propensity. The scale is a mean per-residue aggregation score, negative for aggregation-averse sequences.
The direction's functional score is 0.873, produced by iMFP-LG (AIP channel).
That score is a ranking signal, not a probability. It separates functional-looking peptides from random fragments rather than measuring activity, so it is used for ordering only.

blocks.title: Linker and assembly
blocks.content:
The linker is GGGGS, 5 residues long, classified as Flexible.
A glycine-serine linker of this kind gives the fused peptide rotational freedom and separates it from the scaffold surface, which matters when the functional epitope would otherwise be masked by the scaffold. The trade-off is that the unstructured segment is more exposed to proteases.
The linker sequence recorded here comes from the sample linker table rather than the curated library, and the construct carries no verified linker choice: the assembly step that produced it picked the first available row.
The construct's stored scaffold binding is `placeholder`. No fused sequence is emitted, because the bound scaffold row holds a marker string rather than a real sequence.

blocks.title: Expression and handling
blocks.content:
Recommended route: Escherichia coli, strain BL21(DE3), pET SUMO with an N-terminal His6-SUMO tag, cleaved with Ulp1 after capture.
Induction: 0.2 mM IPTG at OD600 0.6–0.8, 16 °C, 18–20 h. Purification: Ni-NTA capture, Ulp1 cleavage, then size exclusion.
This is a recommendation rather than a stored condition: the dataset records no expression host, vector or induction condition for any construct. It is derived from the peptide's predicted properties, its composition, and — where one is bound — the scaffold's class.
Two properties point the same way. Predicted solubility is 0.021 (SoDoPE), under the 0.45 planning cut used here, and 50% of the peptide's residues are hydrophobic, which is the composition that drives inclusion-body formation. The route therefore adds a His6-SUMO fusion and drops induction to 16 °C: the fusion partner keeps the peptide from collapsing into inclusion bodies, and the lower temperature slows aggregation faster than it slows expression. The cost is one cleavage step and a second chromatography run.
One cysteine is present, which cannot form an intrachain disulfide on its own and instead cross-links neighbouring molecules on storage. A reducing agent is kept in the buffer until the final step.
Predicted thermal stability is 0.290 (TemStaPro). It does not enter the host choice; it bears on storage temperature and on any heating step after purification.
No scaffold is bound to this construct — the stored binding is a placeholder — so the carrier sequence and the construct's total length are unknown, and the host stays at the E. coli default. Binding a library scaffold moves the route to P. pastoris when that scaffold is a recombinant-collagen fragment longer than 600 residues, and to a recA-deficient strain when it is a repeat-rich silk or collagen.
With no fused sequence on the record, a synthetic gene cannot be ordered until that binding is filled in; the route above describes what to do once it is.

plan.tag: an N-terminal His6-SUMO tag, cleaved with Ulp1 after capture
plan.purification: Ni-NTA capture, Ulp1 cleavage, then size exclusion

blocks.title: Risk register
blocks.content:
Not assessed for this construct: immunogenicity.
Veto gates without a measurement: immunogenicity. These are reported as unassessed rather than as passing.
No fused sequence is available, because the scaffold binding is a placeholder. Any downstream step that needs the full construct sequence cannot proceed on this record.
The construct carries the status WIP. Its direction has not been signed off, so its rank should not be read as a settled ordering.
This construct sits in the bottom channel, which exists as a negative control for comparison rather than as a candidate.
